WAGE.why: evidence: memory (no source). Named adventure-game engine; the expansion alias is unverified but harmless.

CryEngine.why: Named proprietary studio engine (Crytek), widely known.

Mohawk.why: Named multimedia engine behind Broderbund titles; deep cut, so Heisenbug fits.

Snowdrop.why: Named proprietary studio engine (Ubisoft Snowdrop); NPE fits.

SAGA.why: Named adventure engine (ScummVM SAGA); specialist-level, Heisenbug fits.

qdEngine.why: Named proprietary studio engine (Quantum Dream/Nival lineage); deep cut, Heisenbug fits.

Panda3D.why: Named real-time open-source game engine; NPE fits.

HUGO.why: Hugo is a turn-based text-adventure authoring system, not a real-time engine or a proprietary studio engine, so it falls outside the Accepts line.

Gamebryo.why: Named real-time proprietary engine (Gamebryo/NetImmerse lineage); NPE fits.

GrimE.why: Named proprietary engine behind Grim Fandango; specialist-level, Race condition fits.

Macromedia Director.why: Named proprietary multimedia/game-authoring platform with a public name, used for games; NPE fits.

Creation Engine.why: Named proprietary real-time studio engine (Bethesda); NPE fits.

Frostbite.why: Named proprietary studio engine (EA); well known to gamers, Off-by-one plausible.

Cryo Omni3D.why: Named proprietary studio engine (Cryo Interactive); deep cut, Heisenbug fits.

Wintermute Engine.why: Named open-source adventure engine; specialist-level, Race condition fits.

MADS.why: Named proprietary adventure engine (ScummVM MADS); deep cut, Heisenbug fits.

Infinity Engine.why: Named proprietary studio engine (BioWare); NPE fits.

Construct.why: Named real-time engine (Scirra Construct), and the version aliases are the same product. Off-by-one overstates how many people name it first; NPE fits better.

HPL1 Engine.why: Named proprietary studio engine (Frictional Games); specialist-level, Race condition fits.

GameMaker.why: Named real-time engine (GameMaker Studio); well known among indie developers, Off-by-one plausible. GM Studio is an abbreviation alias.
